resources.string: Customers are hungry! Grab the right ingredients from the fridge before they lose patience.

🧑‍🍳 A customer orders one of 50 FridgeChef dishes.
🧊 Tap the right ingredients in your fridge.
✅ Correct ingredient: +10 points
❌ Wrong ingredient: −5 points and −1 second
🍽️ Dish served: +50 points + time bonus
🔥 Serve dishes in a row with no mistakes for a combo (x2, x3)
💔 If a customer waits too long, they leave and you lose a heart
⭐ Every 3 dishes the level goes up and customers get less patient
